source: design §2.29 (validator V5); owner decisions §10 items 2 and 6, plus D1-D10 (2026-10-20, all recommendations accepted)
rule: Rendered tag = card authority mapped by renderMap, then the stricter tag of any entry below. Every tool that is both in LPM SENSITIVE_ADMIN_TOOLS and carded autonomous must have exactly one entry in sensitiveAutonomous; V5 fails otherwise.

ownerDecisions.decision: Accept §2.29: raise 2 sensitive autonomous tools to [C] and keep 26 at [A] with reasons.
ownerDecisions.alternativeRejected: Raise every sensitive write (17 tools); it stalls runner loops.

ownerDecisions.decision: Static [O] for the six roadmap-structure writes. In `shadow`/`enforce`, item creation runs only on the owner's explicit order (draft first); later changes go through change requests.
ownerDecisions.alternativeRejected: [C] in mode `off` and [O] otherwise; the tag would depend on state a low-reasoning agent must read correctly.

ownerDecisions.decision: Release order: LPM parity merge → agents-skills v2 merge → deploy candidate. E3 only for high-risk flows before merge. LEGACY_MODE_EXPIRES = deploy date + 30 days.

[O] = only get_workspace.ownerId. Agent verifies by email via list_workspace_members role owner. Mismatch → decision request. Backlog: expose userId in get_mcp_connection_info. The rule 'never mint tokens for a real user' stays unchanged.
(a) Item creation [O] static until create governado exists. (b) Enforce: owner order + second confirmation citing enforce mode. CR-equivalent paths stay via CR.
review_workspace_roadmap_change: any eligible human reviewer. submit/apply/outbox: owner or admin. revise: author. withdraw: author [C], others [O].
delete_knowledge_item [C→O]. create_export_request workspace scope [C→O]. update_project routingProfile [C→O]. Labels: keep [C]. Host enrollment: keep [C]. Issue links: [C] without manage.
Governance link-back is [A] when it only fills actionTargetType and actionTargetId of an existing actionable outcome.
Pilot feedback never writes to the client's managed workspace. Classified as managed-workspace-demand with a decision request for the owner.
Promotion to 100% needs an explicit 'yes' (not implied by 'deploy'). Merge to main before promotion. New candidate if merge changes content.
Open all listed LPM product gaps as backlog items. Skills continue with interims.
V14 splits generic refs. E2 keeps 23 descriptions. Manifest one agent per folder. demo-prep kept.

governanceRaises.reason: Roadmap changes are proposals for the owner's decision unless the owner authorizes them. On a connector, the person who says yes may not be the owner. In `shadow`/`enforce` mode a new item is created only on the owner's explicit order (`create_workspace_roadmap_item` [O] without `lifecycle`, so it starts as a draft, or `commit_owner_roadmap_change`); later changes go through change requests. `changeType: create` is not a working path: preview needs existing item ids and apply writes nothing for it.

governanceRaises.rule: Routing ADR (project-scoped artifacts only through a routing confirmation)
governanceRaises.reason: Project-scoped artifacts are created only through a routing confirmation. The legacy routing digest: direct creation needs the owner's explicit choice.

governanceRaises.rule: Permanent records: show the exact call and wait for yes
governanceRaises.reason: Each call adds a permanent protocol evidence record (no delete tool, no dedupe), uses a limited per-kind slot (image 10, audio 5, video 3, document 5, other 3; 20 files / 100 MB in total) and sets the protocol's lastInternalStatus. The agent cannot verify the 'stored and sanitized' precondition: show kind, fileName, size, sha256 and redactionState and wait for yes.
